description: This PHP file defines the Startup class within the Opencart admin model setting namespace. It provides methods for managing startup records in a database, including adding, deleting, updating, retrieving individual, multiple, and total startup records. The class interacts with a database abstraction layer and appears to be part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin backend.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: A model class for managing startup records in the database within Opencart's admin setting module.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Creates a new startup record in the database with provided details.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes a startup record from the database using its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup identified by its ID.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its ID.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Fetches a startup record by its code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of startup records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total count of startup records in the database.
